name: Premortem Analysis
description: Conducts a premortem by imagining a decision has failed one year from now, identifying the specific reasons for failure, and producing a mitigation plan for the top failure modes. Creates a complete premortem report with actionable prevention steps. Use when the user asks about anticipating what could go wrong with a decision, running a premortem, stress-testing a plan, or identifying failure modes before committing. Do NOT use for project risk registers (use risk-assessment), comparing options with scoring (use weighted-decision-matrix), or business strategic risk analysis (use business strategy skills).
